text:
maria (Partnerships): Quick shoutout — Cerulean Analytics went live with our AWS Marketplace connector this morning and their pilot is already showing great results. Joint case study & marketplace listing published: https://marketplace.aws/cerulean-redwood-connector :tada:

partners-bot: Marketplace listing status: PUBLISHED — Cerulean Analytics connector (aws:us-east-1). Listing URL: https://marketplace.aws/cerulean-redwood-connector

devon (Sales): Amazing news, huge congrats team! Any topline numbers we can share in the customer-facing email? :rocket:

maria (Partnerships): Topline: during their 2-week pilot on Dedicated we helped reduce median inference latency by ~40% for their query workloads and lowered cost-per-1000 tokens by ~25% with batching + prefix caching. Full numbers in the doc: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/cerulean-case-study (internal)

leah (Product Marketing): Love it. Can we get a 2-sentence blurb and one quote from the Cerulean PM for the press note? I'll prep the newsletter slot. Also tagging @devon for the customer quote follow-up.

devon (Sales): On it — reached out to Cerulean PM (Asha) earlier, she said she'd share a short quote by EOD.

sam (Eng): FYI for runtime folks — Cerulean's workload skewed short-turn queries with 1–3 tokens per turn but very high QPS. We tuned batching window and KV prefix caching; also enabled int8 quant for their reranker model which saved GPU memory. Dropped tail latency p95 from 220ms -> 130ms.

maria (Partnerships): Nice, @sam — can you paste the config snippet you used so we can include an ops callout?

sam (Eng): Sure — snippet below (internal):
```
routing_policy: dedicated-primary
batching:
  max_batch_ms: 12
  preferred_batch_size: 32
caching:
  prefix_kv: true
quantization:
  engine: int8
  model_whitelist: ["reranker-v2"]
```

leah (Product Marketing): Perfect — I'll add that to the case study tech appendix. Also want a short GIF for the newsletter — @maria can you grab a 15s clip from the demo?

maria (Partnerships): Yep, will pull a short clip from their demo session later today.

devon (Sales): Quick ask — can Partnerships confirm whether this counts toward our AWS co-sell metrics? Need to flag for revenue ops.

maria (Partnerships): Confirmed with partnerships ops: yes, this qualifies as an AWS Marketplace co-sell opportunity. I'll forward the paperwork.

partners-bot: Internal note added to partnership record: partner_id=CERULEAN-0023, go_live_ts=2065432100, co_sell=true

sam (Eng): Also noting one gotcha — Cerulean's CI surfaced an edge case where our KV cache eviction metric spiked during nightly batch jobs. We patched and added an alert rule: `kv_cache.evictions > 1000 in 5m` -> trigger auto-scale.

maria (Partnerships): Great ops handoff. Thanks everyone — big win for marketplace motion and dedicated play. Small next steps: 1) Leah to finalize press blurb, 2) Devon to collect customer quote, 3) Sam to add config & alert to the public appendix, 4) I'll publish the joint case study to the partner portal and share a social-ready asset pack.

leah (Product Marketing): ETA for press blurb: EOD PST.

devon (Sales): ETA for quote: EOD PST (Asha confirmed).

sam (Eng): I'll push the config & alert into the doc in 1 hour.

maria (Partnerships): Thanks team! :confetti_ball: I'll drop the partner portal link here when the doc is live.
